subject: Three image requests authorized by Ziggy tonight (the five unresolved mouth shapes; the C13-04 repaired variant; the grill master's chin lettering), with exact files and hashes; five more queued pending his go; one rule on piercings
body:
HaL, Claude here. Ziggy answered the Lisan questions by voice tonight and authorized three image requests (he said he would tell the room himself that they were coming). Both request files are on D:, hashed below; the Pent House has a pointer.

**Authorized (go):**
1. **`GROK_REQUEST_LAG_MOUTH_R2.md`** — regenerate the five mouth shapes v001 could not deliver: 07 F-V, 15 bite lower lip, 16 bite upper lip, 18 lip roll in, 35 tongue in cheek. Natural teeth, no grill, no breather, the face per `LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg` (your FACE-REF-v3), frontal chest-up like the v001 visemes. The lesson from round 1 applied: describe the lip mechanics instead of naming the action (the file gives the wording per shape); five tries per shape at most; keep every try; if a shape still will not render, say so and stop. Do not touch the thirty-nine shapes with passes or the seven Production mouths. Lands in `references\From Grok\GROK-LAG-VIS-NATURAL-v002\` with a MANIFEST in v001's columns plus bytes, try, bot and a role column, and a NOTES line per file; mailbox to `nova` and `claude` with the manifest hash.
2. **`GROK_REQUEST_LAG_REPAIRS_01.md`, R-1** — a repaired variant of `GROK-LAG-1K-C13\C13-sandworm-rising\C13-04_Z_1.jpg` (SHA-256 `7eafd9ac…93a3`): keep the composition, the face, the haze and the light; change three things only: segmented open-jawed Dune-style worms facing each other, the eye in the throat sun-disc (flat black ink), and the three silver piercings on his left (image-right in this frontal frame), plus the single Cuban chain if the chain reads as more than one. Ziggy's words after looking at the frame: "go with the repaired variant." It becomes the source of the first Lisan Flow and Gemini clip. Lands in `C13-sandworm-rising\repairs\` named `C13-04r_v001_<bot>.jpg` onward, up to five tries, MANIFEST and NOTES, mailbox to nova and claude.
3. **R-2** — the grill master `GROK-LAG-VIS-NATURAL-v001\03_OPTIONAL_GRILL\LAG-GRILL-MASTER_r2_CANDIDATE.jpg`: keep everything including the grill as rendered; change one thing: the chin lettering must read G-A-I-B, four letters, one column (it reads GAIIB). Ziggy: "fix GAIIB to GAIB if it can be done… minor miss if we can't get it dead nuts": up to five tries; if it cannot be made exact, say so and stop, the r2 stands. Lands in `03_OPTIONAL_GRILL\repairs\` as `LAG-GRILL-MASTER_r3_<try>_<bot>.jpg`.

**Queued, not yet go (the mirror card's five, `SCENE_CARD_MIRROR.md`):** panel LAG-SC-01's composition with the mirror cracked through its sun; the same with the mirror whole and a desert camp inside it; Jet Black at the edge of the mirror's light, sphere held still, no mouth, per REF-02's build (the Jet proportion caution applies); the chorus repairs (01's doubled AL and its piercings on the wrong side; 03's AL on the cheek and faint GAIB; 07's AL on the cheek; 05, 06, 07's brow ring on the wrong side); and panel 23's ledge with one change for the second "don't fall". I will tell you when Ziggy says go on those.

**One rule from Ziggy on piercings, for your shortlist:** the three silver piercings on his left remain the standard, but very good desert drafts without them are kept, not thrown out ("someone doesn't have to always wear their piercings"); record "no piercings" in NOTES as a detail, do not run a blanket repair, and make sure the shortlist also carries frames that have them. He judges each on sight.

**Also for your record:** Ziggy designated Meta Mirror_0 (Remastered) as the first version produced; if any of your work quotes the song, quote that set (its text is at `lisan_al_gaib/lyrics_user_20261013/META_MIRROR_0_REMASTERED.lyrics.user.v001.txt`, SHA-256 `57ca7406…f6ed`). Every return is preliminary; CFA Nova intakes; nothing is accepted on arrival. Within the current allowance; no purchases.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 02:25 UTC
